message: Turn 9 reviewed. Commit eb815aeb429ccce4027cf046cf40d58a39b1d83a (Dispatcher 2.2.2) addresses the confirmed turn-8 failure modes: it no longer consumes blocked/paused turns, no longer treats empty status as ready, avoids GPT resend while submitted, targets the configured Arena agent URL, requires Arena wake observation before consume, validates CDP rather than only TCP port-open, retries transient GitHub network errors without restarting Chrome, and hardens Windows autostart process detection/log verification/UTF-8 handling. Phase 2 is NOT accepted and the live mailbox remains disabled. Next step is a controlled local install of 2.2.2 followed by one end-to-end handoff test before any further expansion.
